objective: Make Online Consultation the primary Health Center card experience on Public Home while preserving a separate standalone PWA doorway and one policy-compliant ad banner.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-10 inspected Main card direct Health Center URL, existing Profile fallback, existing global focus-app banner, and unactivated standalone AI consultation; 2026-11-10 standalone HC rebuilt cloud branch source only, not yet confirmed production published. Reconciled again on latest main a4badb341c16444fa42c44a5e0906760b85d2a08; unrelated Kingdom and staging main commits retained, not copied into the HC diff.
chosenApproach: Recompose Home Health card into explicit online consultation and standalone actions. The Profile route provides local-only topic choice and emergency precheck, then fixed HTTPS paths with no user health details in links. Move one passive ad from global strip to in-screen safe nonurgent context with existing AdMob/Web bridge.
preserveBehaviors: Bahay card square layout and navigation
Main Health Center route available to ordinary members (not Health Worker role)
No BUKLOD credentials or patient records shared
No new native modules or runtime changes
No forced ads or ads in urgent warning state
No changes to Classroom, Quiz, Supabase or production Health Center
No OTA or web deployment from DEV
No AI/professional CTA claims service is live before fail-closed client activation.
acceptanceChecks: Two independent accessible buttons inside Health Center card
Urgent yes or unsure disables AI route and hides banner
Nonurgent choice allows AI standalone door
Single visible ad banner with consent/provider controls and viewport gate
Explicit provider status on AI standalone and no token handoff
Tests, TypeScript, Android+web source compile before OTA readiness
Consultation and verified professional routes default to disabled until standalone backend and access controls are production-verified; no broken-404 link presented.
selectionRationale: Protects sensitive healthcare use: leaves AI computation, medical records, professional licensing and cloud persistence inside standalone HC. Main receives no patient text or credentials. Existing ads SDK, remote targeting consent and safe request throttling remain intact. One banner is shown only after nonurgent screening to avoid distracting emergency action.
alternativeApproaches: Embedding the full standalone patient app or records into BUKLOD Main: rejected due to cross-account privacy/security and code duplication.
Opening the standalone website automatically from the Home tile: rejected because user requires in-card online consultation first and an explicit separate full HC door.
Serving a second Home/Global focus banner before medical screening: rejected because it would duplicate ad requests and distract from safety checks.
Passing selected symptoms/topics in deep-link query parameters: rejected because browser history, analytics and external log systems may retain sensitive data.
